2608.21558.title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation
2608.21558.paper_summary: Recent advances in LLMs and the adoption of RAG systems in industry have created a need for domain-specific question-answer datasets that can assess RAG performance on proprietary data. Existing datasets, such as HotpotQA, challenge current RAG systems on Wikipedia-based knowledge, but they cannot be transferred directly to domain-specific settings. A comprehensive evaluation of RAG system quality requires both multi-hop queries and unanswerable questions. This paper introduces TRIAD, a three-stage automated dataset generation approach. First, it generates question--answer (QA) pairs for the domain-specific knowledge base of a RAG system. Second, a validator checks each QA-pair in a feedback loop. Third, the QA pairs are extended with relevance-labeled context documents for downstream evaluation. We evaluate this approach against the established MuSiQue and HotpotQA datasets. The results show that the generated dataset exhibits similar performance trends across different RAG setups, while human validation indicates that the questions are suitable for evaluating a domain-specific RAG system. The code used to generate the dataset and all validation results are available in our GitHub repository(https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/triad).
2608.21558.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展以及行業中對檢索增強生成（RAG）系統的採用，促使對能夠評估RAG在專有數據上表現的特定領域問題-答案數據集的需求。現有數據集，如HotpotQA，對基於維基百科的知識挑戰當前的RAG系統，但它們不能直接轉移到特定領域的環境中。對RAG系統質量的全面評估需要多跳查詢和無法回答的問題。本文介紹了TRIAD，一種三階段的自動數據集生成方法。首先，它為RAG系統的特定領域知識庫生成問題-答案（QA）對。其次，驗證者在反饋循環中檢查每個QA對。第三，QA對通過相關標籤的上下文文檔進行擴展，以便進行下游評估。我們將這種方法與已建立的MuSiQue和HotpotQA數據集進行比較。結果顯示，生成的數據集在不同的RAG設置中展現出相似的性能趨勢，而人類驗證則表明這些問題適合用於評估特定領域的RAG系統。用於生成數據集的代碼和所有驗證結果可在我們的GitHub存儲庫中獲得(https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/triad)。
